notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation declares stable-population, page-size, clock, work-weight, and comparison assumptions rather than treating request counts, latency, or HTTP conformance as data fitness.

evidence: Executed api-pagination-request-bound with Python 3.14.4 and reproduced 1,030 records, page size 250, five minimum requests, four full pages, thirty last-page records, and 220 unused last-page slots.
Recomputed ceiling division as (1030+250-1) integer-divided by 250 and quotient-remainder as divmod(1030,250).
Verified that four multiplied by 250 plus 30 equals 1,030 and that 250 minus 30 equals 220.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The results are exact only for a stable authorized collection with fulfilled page sizes and no request failures, retries, concurrent changes, or changing filters.

evidence: Re-derived Q(N,p)=ceil(N/p) for N nonnegative and p positive, including exact-division and partial-last-page cases.
Checked weighted offered load as a planning abstraction and freshness age as source-observation-to-response difference under declared clocks and provenance.
Reviewed lifecycle-cost comparison while preserving workload, time, service, protection, horizon, units, risk, and non-additive outcomes.
